choose.when: ;WITH gc AS (SELECT CASE WHEN p.division='MP' THEN N'양산' ELSE N'개발' END 구분, p.도우코드, SUM(ISNULL(p.OUTPUT_A,0)+ISNULL(p.TOTAL_EOH_전,0)*0.5+ISNULL(p.TOTAL_EOH_후,0)*0.9) 환산량, MAX(ISNULL(mm.xy,0)) 면적 FROM doi_vn_prod_resc p LEFT JOIN DOI_MODEL_MAST mm ON mm.MODEL=p.도우코드 AND mm.yyyymm=p.yyyymm AND mm.site='VN' AND mm.sel_code=p.sel_code WHERE p.sel_code='ACTUAL' AND p.YYYYMM = #{yyyymm} GROUP BY p.division, p.도우코드), tot AS (SELECT SUM(환산량*면적) s FROM gc), mi AS (SELECT 품번, MAX(품명) 품명 FROM doi_matl_resc WHERE 1=1 AND YYYYMM = #{yyyymm} AND SITE = #{site} GROUP BY 품번) SELECT e.구분, e.YYYYMM as yyyymm, e.SEL_CODE as sel_code, CASE WHEN e.SITE='HQ' THEN '본사' WHEN e.SITE='VN' THEN 'VINA' END AS SITE, e.도우코드 as 도우모델, e.항목 자재번호, mi.품명 자재명, e.EXPEN_SEL expen_sel, e.expen_sel명, CASE WHEN e.EXPEN_SEL='MDAX' THEN N'원자재' ELSE N'부자재' END mat_class, CAST(e.투입금액 AS numeric(18,2)) in_amt, r.환산량, NULL 소요량, CASE WHEN e.배부방식=N'공통' THEN r.면적 ELSE NULL END 면적, CASE WHEN e.배부방식=N'공통' THEN CAST(r.환산량*r.면적 AS numeric(18,2)) ELSE NULL END 배부적수, CASE WHEN e.배부방식=N'공통' THEN r.환산량*r.면적/NULLIF(t.s,0) ELSE NULL END 배부율, CAST(e.투입금액 AS numeric(18,2)) 배부금액, e.배부방식 FROM doi_expn_matl e LEFT JOIN gc r ON r.구분=e.구분 AND r.도우코드=e.도우코드 CROSS JOIN tot t LEFT JOIN mi ON mi.품번=e.항목 WHERE e.원가구분=N'재료비' AND e.sel_code='ACTUAL' AND e.YYYYMM = #{yyyymm} AND e.SITE = #{site} ORDER BY e.배부방식 DESC, e.구분, e.항목;

;WITH gc AS (SELECT CASE WHEN p.division='MP' THEN N'양산' ELSE N'개발' END 구분, p.도우코드, SUM(ISNULL(p.OUTPUT_A,0)+ISNULL(p.TOTAL_EOH_전,0)*0.5+ISNULL(p.TOTAL_EOH_후,0)*0.9) 환산량, MAX(ISNULL(mm.xy,0)) 면적 FROM doi_vn_prod_resc p LEFT JOIN DOI_MODEL_MAST mm ON mm.MODEL=p.도우코드 AND mm.yyyymm=p.yyyymm AND mm.site='VN' AND mm.sel_code=p.sel_code WHERE p.sel_code='ACTUAL' AND p.YYYYMM = #{yyyymm} GROUP BY p.division, p.도우코드) SELECT e.YYYYMM as yyyymm, e.SEL_CODE as sel_code, e.SITE as site, e.도우코드 as 도우모델, e.항목 자재번호, CASE WHEN e.EXPEN_SEL='MDAX' THEN N'원자재' ELSE N'부자재' END mat_class, e.분류 자재대분류, CAST(e.투입금액 AS numeric(18,2)) in_amt, r.환산량, NULL 소요량, CASE WHEN e.배부방식=N'공통' THEN CAST(r.환산량*r.면적 AS numeric(18,2)) ELSE NULL END 배부적수, CAST(e.투입금액 AS numeric(18,2)) 배부금액, CASE WHEN e.배부방식=N'공통' THEN CAST(r.환산량*r.면적 AS numeric(18,2)) ELSE NULL END 사용량 FROM doi_expn_matl e LEFT JOIN gc r ON r.구분=e.구분 AND r.도우코드=e.도우코드 WHERE e.원가구분=N'재료비' AND e.sel_code='ACTUAL' AND e.YYYYMM = #{yyyymm} AND e.SITE = #{site} AND (CASE WHEN e.EXPEN_SEL='MDAX' THEN N'원자재' ELSE N'부자재' END) = #{matClass} order by 1,2,3,4,5,6;

select 구분, 도우코드 as 도우모델, case when EXPEN_SEL='MDAX' then 'MDAX' else 'MIDX' end as expen_sel, case when EXPEN_SEL='MDAX' then N'직접재료비' else N'간접재료비' end as expen_sel명, sum(CAST(투입금액 AS numeric(18,2))) 배부금액 from doi_expn_matl where sel_code='ACTUAL' and 원가구분=N'재료비' and YYYYMM = #{yyyymm} and SITE = #{site} group by 구분, 도우코드, case when EXPEN_SEL='MDAX' then 'MDAX' else 'MIDX' end, case when EXPEN_SEL='MDAX' then N'직접재료비' else N'간접재료비' end order by 1,2;

;WITH gc AS (SELECT CASE WHEN p.division='MP' THEN N'양산' ELSE N'개발' END 구분, p.도우코드, SUM(ISNULL(p.OUTPUT_A,0)+ISNULL(p.TOTAL_EOH_전,0)*0.5+ISNULL(p.TOTAL_EOH_후,0)*0.9) 환산량, MAX(ISNULL(mm.xy,0)) 면적 FROM doi_vn_prod_resc p LEFT JOIN DOI_MODEL_MAST mm ON mm.MODEL=p.도우코드 AND mm.yyyymm=p.yyyymm AND mm.site='VN' AND mm.sel_code=p.sel_code WHERE p.sel_code='ACTUAL' AND p.YYYYMM = #{yyyymm} GROUP BY p.division, p.도우코드), tot AS (SELECT SUM(환산량*면적) s FROM gc) select e.YYYYMM as yyyymm, e.SEL_CODE as sel_code, e.SITE as site, e.도우코드 as 도우모델, e.항목 자재번호, CASE WHEN e.EXPEN_SEL='MDAX' THEN N'원자재' ELSE N'부자재' END mat_class, e.분류 자재대분류, CAST(e.투입금액 AS numeric(18,2)) in_amt, r.환산량, NULL 소요량, CASE WHEN e.배부방식=N'공통' THEN r.환산량*r.면적/NULLIF(t.s,0) ELSE NULL END 배부율, CAST(e.투입금액 AS numeric(18,2)) 배부금액, CASE WHEN e.배부방식=N'공통' THEN CAST(r.환산량*r.면적 AS numeric(18,2)) ELSE NULL END 사용량, e.배부방식 from doi_expn_matl e LEFT JOIN gc r ON r.구분=e.구분 AND r.도우코드=e.도우코드 CROSS JOIN tot t where e.원가구분=N'재료비' AND e.sel_code='ACTUAL' AND e.YYYYMM = #{yyyymm} AND e.SITE = #{site} AND e.도우코드 = #{model} AND e.구분 = #{gubun} order by 1,2,3,4,5,6;

;WITH gc AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN p.division='MP' THEN N'양산' ELSE N'개발' END 구분, p.도우코드, LEFT(p.도우코드,LEN(p.도우코드)-1) 도우모델, SUM(ISNULL(p.OUTPUT_A,0)+ISNULL(p.TOTAL_EOH_전,0)*0.5+ISNULL(p.TOTAL_EOH_후,0)*0.9) adj_qty, SUM(ISNULL(p.USC_INPUT,0)) in_qty, SUM(ISNULL(p.OUTPUT_A,0)) out_qty, SUM(ISNULL(p.LOSS_전,0)+ISNULL(p.LOSS_후,0)) loss_qty, MAX(ISNULL(mm.xy,0)) 면적 FROM doi_vn_prod_resc p LEFT JOIN DOI_MODEL_MAST mm ON mm.MODEL=p.도우코드 AND mm.yyyymm=p.yyyymm AND mm.site='VN' AND mm.sel_code=p.sel_code WHERE p.sel_code='ACTUAL' AND p.YYYYMM = #{yyyymm} GROUP BY p.division, p.도우코드 ), tot AS (SELECT SUM(adj_qty*면적) s FROM gc) SELECT c.구분, c.도우코드 as model, c.면적, CAST(c.adj_qty*c.면적 AS numeric(18,2)) DIST_VALUE, c.adj_qty*c.면적/NULLIF(t.s,0) dist_rate, e.항목 SUB_NAME, e.EXPEN_SEL, e.expen_sel명 as EXPEN_SEL명, c.adj_qty, c.in_qty, c.out_qty, c.loss_qty, 0 as disp_seq, e.input_Amt FROM gc c CROSS JOIN tot t JOIN (SELECT 구분,도우코드,EXPEN_SEL,MAX(expen_sel명) expen_sel명, MAX(항목) 항목, SUM(CAST(투입금액 AS float)) input_Amt FROM doi_expn_matl WHERE sel_code='ACTUAL' AND 원가구분=N'가공비' AND YYYYMM = #{yyyymm} AND SITE = #{site} GROUP BY 구분,도우코드,EXPEN_SEL) e ON e.구분=c.구분 AND e.도우코드=c.도우코드 ORDER BY c.구분, c.도우코드, e.EXPEN_SEL;

mapper.select:
WITH dist_cost AS (
SELECT '제조경비' AS GUBUN, FROM_DEPT_CODE, FROM_DEPT_NAME, FROM_ACCT_CODE, FROM_ACCT_NAME, EXPEN_SEL, EXPEN_SEL_NAME, ACCT_AMT, 1 AS seq FROM DOI_MFG_EXP WHERE yyyymm = #{yyyymm} AND site = #{site}
UNION ALL
SELECT '연구개발부서' AS GUBUN, FROM_DEPT_CODE, FROM_DEPT_NAME, FROM_ACCT_CODE, FROM_ACCT_NAME, EXPEN_SEL, EXPEN_SEL_NAME, ACCT_AMT, 2 AS seq FROM DOI_RND WHERE yyyymm = #{yyyymm} AND site = #{site} AND cost_type = '제조비용'
UNION ALL
SELECT '카세트팀' AS GUBUN, FROM_DEPT_CODE, FROM_DEPT_NAME, FROM_ACCT_CODE, FROM_ACCT_NAME, EXPEN_SEL, EXPEN_SEL_NAME, ACCT_AMT, 3 AS seq FROM DOI_CASET WHERE yyyymm = #{yyyymm} AND site = #{site}
UNION ALL
SELECT '판매관리비' AS GUBUN, FROM_DEPT_CODE, FROM_DEPT_NAME, FROM_ACCT_CODE, FROM_ACCT_NAME, EXPEN_SEL, EXPEN_SEL_NAME, ACCT_AMT, 4 AS seq FROM DOI_SGA WHERE yyyymm = #{yyyymm} AND site = #{site}
UNION ALL
SELECT '연구개발부서(비제조)' AS GUBUN, FROM_DEPT_CODE, FROM_DEPT_NAME, FROM_ACCT_CODE, FROM_ACCT_NAME, EXPEN_SEL, EXPEN_SEL_NAME, ACCT_AMT, 5 AS seq FROM DOI_RND WHERE yyyymm = #{yyyymm} AND site = #{site} AND cost_type != '제조비용' ) SELECT * FROM dist_cost WHERE 1=1
AND seq IN (1, 2, 3)
AND seq IN (4, 5)
AND seq = CAST(#{seq} AS INT)
ORDER BY seq
